notes: Two branches: the first gives only موسى بن إسماعيل and حماد, with no names after; the second is read in full
«قال نصر: ابن نهار» gives Shatir's name in fuller form: a remark on the same link, left out (not a different transmitter)
«قال أبو داود ولم أفهمه منه جيدا» and «قال نصر» are compiler and transmitter glosses, left out
